[[Turoth]] can be assigned as a [[Slayer task]] from [[Vannaka]], [[Nieve]]/[[Steve]], [[Chaeldar]], [[Konar quo Maten]], or [[Mortimer]], requiring 55 [[Slayer]] and 60 [[Combat level|combat]]. They are melee based, and as such [[Protect from Melee]] will negate all of their damage. They are '''only''' found in the [[Fremennik Slayer Dungeon]]. 

Turoth can only be damaged with [[leaf-bladed weapons]], [[broad arrows]] and [[broad bolts|bolts]], or the [[Magic dart|Magic Dart]] spell. Attacking with any other weapons or spells will always deal 0 damage.

The superior variant is the [[Spiked Turoth|spiked turoth]]; the ''Bigger and Badder'' Slayer reward must be unlocked for it to spawn.

Due to their high herb drop rates, it is recommended players bring a [[herb sack]] with them for the task if they have one.

==Strategy==
[[File:Turoth (Fremennik Slayer Dungeon, south) safespot.png|thumb|A safespot]]
[[File:Turoth (Fremennik Slayer Dungeon, east) safespot.png|thumb|Another safespot]]

===Melee===
*[[Leaf-bladed battleaxe]] > [[leaf-bladed sword]] > [[leaf-bladed spear]]
*Decent melee armour ([[Rune equipment#Armour|rune]] or higher, ideally), [[Slayer helmet]] or [[black mask]]
*[[Super set]], [[combat potion]], or other stat boosting potions
*[[Nature rune]]s and a [[fire staff]] or [[fire rune]]s to [[Alchemy spells|alchemise]] various drops
*A [[herb sack]]
*Method of healing if using weaker armours such as:
**[[Bones to Peaches]]
**[[Food]] (preferably [[lobster]] or better)
***Note: If you happen to run out of food, you can [[Pray flick|Prayer flick]] [[Protect from Melee]].
***Note: Remember that you need inventory space for herbs and seeds.
***Note: You can bring the [[Saradomin godsword]] or the [[Ancient mace]], although it won't hit, it heals with the damage it would have done. <ref>[[Turoth#:~:text=Although Turoth are,does not work.]]</ref>

===Ranged===
Use your best crossbow or bow that can fire [[broad bolts]] or [[broad arrows]], optionally use [[amethyst broad bolts]] for an additional +15 ranged strength.
*Decent ranged armour, [[Slayer helmet (i)]] or [[black mask (i)]]
*[[Ranging potion]] or [[Ranging mix|mix]]
*[[Nature rune]]s and a [[fire staff]] or [[fire rune]]s to [[Alchemy spells|alchemise]] various drops
*A [[herb sack]]
*Method of healing (if not using the [[safespot]])
**Note: [[Bones to peaches]] tablets may prove useful, as they are stackable (healing may prove unnecessary).

===Magic===
*[[Slayer staff]] or [[Staff of the Dead|staff of the dead]]/2000+ casts of [[Magic Dart]]
*Decent magic damage boosting armour, [[Slayer helmet (i)]] or [[black mask (i)]]
*[[Imbued heart]], [[Magic potion]], [[Magic essence]] potion, or [[wizard's mind bomb]]s if desired
*[[Nature rune]]s and a [[fire staff]] or [[fire rune]]s to alchemise various drops
*A [[herb sack]]
*Method of healing (if not using the safespot);
**Note: Safespot is easy to use. [[Bones to peaches]] tablets may prove useful, as they are stackable (healing may prove unnecessary).
